cards.card_text: He brought them up out of Egypt, out of the house of slavery, and He drove out their oppressors and gave them their land.
cards.verse_text: I delivered you out of the hands of Egypt and all your oppressors.
cards.snippet: I delivered you out of the hands of Egypt and all your oppressors.

cards.card_text: In that place where the dead lie, Job says captives still hear the voice of the oppressor.
cards.verse_text: The captives enjoy their ease; they do not hear the voice of the oppressor.
cards.snippet: …captives enjoy their ease; they do not hear the voice of the oppressor.

cards.card_text: David asks for a level path because of his oppressors.
cards.verse_text: Teach me Your way, O LORD, and lead me on a level path, because of my oppressors.
cards.snippet: …O LORD, and lead me on a level path, because of my oppressors.

cards.card_text: Then it turns to the children of the needy, and to the oppressor.
cards.verse_text: May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.
cards.snippet: …people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.

cards.card_text: The prayer asks for the king to ___ the children of the needy and ___ the oppressor.
cards.verse_text: May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.
cards.snippet: …people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.

cards.card_text: He says he has done what is just and right, and he asks the LORD not to leave him to his oppressors.
cards.verse_text: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
cards.snippet: …done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.

cards.card_text: Then a leader who lacks judgment, and friend, the proverb says he's also a great oppressor.
cards.verse_text: A leader who lacks judgment is also a great oppressor, but he who hates dishonest profit will prolong his days.
cards.snippet: A leader who lacks judgment is also a great oppressor, but he who hates dishonest profit will prolong his days.

cards.card_text: Then the proverb puts two people side by side who couldn't be more different: the poor man and the oppressor.
cards.verse_text: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives light to the eyes of both.
cards.snippet: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives light to the eyes of…

cards.card_text: What does the proverb say the poor man and the oppressor have in common?
cards.verse_text: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives light to the eyes of both.
cards.snippet: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives light to the eyes of…

cards.card_text: The oppressed have no comforter, and the Teacher saw that the ___ lay in the hands of their oppressors.
cards.verse_text: I saw the tears of the oppressed, and they had no comforter; the power lay in the hands of their oppressors, and there was no comforter.
cards.snippet: …they had no comforter; the power lay in the hands of their oppressors, and there was no comforter.

cards.card_text: The LORD says, "Stop doing evil!" and "Learn to do right; seek justice and correct the oppressor." So turning off the snooze isn't enough, friend: you gotta actually get UP.
cards.verse_text: Learn to do right; seek justice and correct the oppressor.
cards.snippet: Learn to do right; seek justice and correct the oppressor.

cards.card_text: The LORD tells them to seek justice and correct the oppressor.
cards.verse_text: Learn to do right; seek justice and correct the oppressor.
cards.snippet: Learn to do right; seek justice and correct the oppressor.

cards.card_text: As in the day of Midian, God shatters the rod of their oppressor.
cards.verse_text: For as in the day of Midian You have shattered the yoke of their burden, the bar across their shoulders, and the rod of their oppressor.
cards.snippet: …their burden, the bar across their shoulders, and the rod of their oppressor.

cards.card_text: The song opens with one big exhale: "How the oppressor has ceased, and how his fury has ended!" That's the sigh I let out when a stuck oven timer FINALLY quits beeping, and I only had to put up with that for ten minutes.
cards.verse_text: you will sing this song of contempt against the king of Babylon: How the oppressor has ceased, and how his fury has ended!
cards.snippet: …sing this song of contempt against the king of Babylon: How the oppressor has ceased, and how his fury has ended!

cards.card_text: When the Egyptians cry out to the LORD because of their oppressors, He will send them a savior and defender to rescue them.
cards.verse_text: When they cry out to the LORD because of their oppressors, He will send them a savior and defender to rescue them.
cards.snippet: When they cry out to the LORD because of their oppressors, He will send them a savior and defender to rescue them.

cards.card_text: Now comes a hard question: "Has the LORD struck Israel as He struck her oppressors?" And another one: "Was she killed like those who slayed her?"
cards.verse_text: Has the LORD struck Israel as He struck her oppressors?
cards.snippet: Has the LORD struck Israel as He struck her oppressors?

cards.card_text: Then the LORD says He will make Zion's oppressors eat their own flesh, and they will be drunk on their own blood, as with wine.
cards.verse_text: I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh; they will be drunk on their own blood, as with wine.
cards.snippet: I will make your oppressors eat their own flesh; they will be drunk on their own blood,…

cards.card_text: Then the LORD asks about the oppressor they're so scared of: "But where is the fury of the oppressor?"
cards.verse_text: You live in terror all day long because of the fury of the oppressor who is bent on destruction.
cards.snippet: …live in terror all day long because of the fury of the oppressor who is bent on destruction.

cards.card_text: Then the sons of Zion's oppressors will come, along with everyone who reviled her.
cards.verse_text: The sons of your oppressors will come and bow down to you; all who reviled you will fall facedown at your feet and call you the City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
cards.snippet: The sons of your oppressors will come and bow down to you; all who reviled you will…

cards.card_text: The sons of Zion's oppressors will come to attack her one more time.
cards.verse_text: The sons of your oppressors will come and bow down to you; all who reviled you will fall facedown at your feet and call you the City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
cards.snippet: The sons of your oppressors will come and bow down to you; all who reviled you will…

cards.card_text: The sons of Zion's oppressors and all who reviled her will bow down and fall facedown at Zion's feet.
cards.verse_text: The sons of your oppressors will come and bow down to you; all who reviled you will fall facedown at your feet and call you the City of the LORD, Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
cards.snippet: The sons of your oppressors will come and bow down to you; all who reviled you will…

cards.card_text: Every morning, the house of David is told to administer ___ and rescue the victim of robbery from his oppressor.
cards.verse_text: O house of David, this is what the LORD says: ‘Administer justice every morning, and rescue the victim of robbery from the hand of his oppressor, or My wrath will go forth like fire and burn with no one to extinguish it because of their evil deeds.
cards.snippet: …morning, and rescue the victim of robbery from the hand of his oppressor, or My wrath will go forth like fire and burn with no…

cards.card_text: The LORD tells the king to administer justice and righteousness, and to rescue the victim of robbery from the hand of his oppressor.
cards.verse_text: Rescue the victim of robbery from the hand of his oppressor.
cards.snippet: Rescue the victim of robbery from the hand of his oppressor.

cards.card_text: The sword of the oppressor A long and bitter famine A great swarm of locusts
cards.verse_text: He has left His den like a lion, for their land has been made a desolation by the sword of the oppressor, and because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
cards.snippet: …their land has been made a desolation by the sword of the oppressor, and because of the fierce anger of the LORD.

cards.card_text: Their children will be as in days of old, and He'll punish all their oppressors.
cards.verse_text: Their children will be as in days of old, and their congregation will be established before Me; and I will punish all their oppressors.
cards.snippet: …congregation will be established before Me; and I will punish all their oppressors.

cards.card_text: Now he turns to one more city: "Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!" Friend, when a prophet's been calling out every city on the map and then says ONE MORE, nobody in the room is breathing.
cards.verse_text: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!
cards.snippet: Woe to the city of oppressors, rebellious and defiled!

cards.card_text: The LORD says never again will an oppressor overrun His people.
cards.verse_text: But I will camp around My house because of an army, because of those who march to and fro, and never again will an oppressor overrun My people, for now I keep watch with My own eyes.
cards.snippet: …of those who march to and fro, and never again will an oppressor overrun My people, for now I keep watch with My own eyes.
